name: calendar
pattern: A headless calendar adding single/range date selection and roving focus to day buttons in a consumer-rendered month grid
responsibility: Provides single/range day selection, in-range state outputs, DOM-order roving focus, cancelable change events, and semantic validation. Consumers or servers render months, navigate months, choose week starts, and display holidays/today. The controller does not interpret date semantics or generate appearance/content.

targets.day: A native <button type="button"> with data-calendar-target="day" and a zero-padded data-calendar-value="YYYY-MM-DD"

authorMarkup.gridShape: Render days in chronological order in seven-day weeks so +/-7 navigation reaches the adjacent week. Including adjacent-month days is optional. Mark unavailable days with native disabled.
authorMarkup.chrome: Consumers render month labels, previous/next month buttons, and weekday headings and implement navigation through server rendering, Turbo, or JS. The controller only tracks day-target changes.
authorMarkup.label: Consumers name the calendar and every day button. They decide whether a short day label such as 15 needs additional context through aria-label.
authorMarkup.content: The controller does not generate elements or content.

semanticElements: At least one day target is required, each a native <button type="button"> inside the root.
data-calendar-value must match ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$, be unique, and increase in DOM order, enabling lexical comparison.
mode must be single or range.
Do not validate whether dates exist, such as 2026-02-31. Validate format/order only; consumers must not render nonexistent dates.
contractValidation.invalidMarkup: Validate on connection and day-target changes. Invalid markup prevents listeners, state outputs, roving focus, and public API operations and warns once per connection. Reapply enhancement when valid without another warning. Do not throw.
contractValidation.warning: Disabling warnings describe native <button type="button"> days, unique ascending YYYY-MM-DD values, and single/range mode.

mode.description: Selection mode, specified as a value because it cannot be inferred from markup.

value.description: Selected YYYY-MM-DD date in single mode; an empty string means no selection. Ignored in range mode.

start.description: Range start; an empty string means unset. Ignored in single mode.

end.description: Range end; an empty string means unset. Ignored in single mode.

value.description: Single mode only: assignment synchronizes selection/state without events; an empty string clears selection. In range mode, reads return an empty string and writes do nothing.

start.description: Range mode only: assignment emits no events and clears end when the new start follows it. In single mode, reads return an empty string and writes do nothing.

end.description: Range mode only: assignment emits no events and ignores values before start. In single mode, reads return an empty string and writes do nothing.

calendar:beforechange.when: Before selection changes from trusted day click, including native Enter/Space button activation

detail.value: Single mode only: proposed selected date
detail.previousValue: Single mode only: previous selected date
detail.end: Range mode only: proposed end, or an empty string if unset

calendar:beforechange.effect: On preventDefault(), preserve selection/state and suppress calendar:change.

calendar:change.when: After trusted selection commits, including commitment of the range start alone

detail.value: Single mode only: committed selected date
detail.end: Range mode only; an empty string means unset

events.reason: Use native button click: detail=0 means keyboard, otherwise pointer.
events.sameValue: Reclicking the selected day in single mode emits no event.
events.programmatic: value/start/end assignment, initialization, reconnection, and restoration after target replacement emit no custom events.
events.synthetic: Clicks with isTrusted=false change neither selection nor events.

consumerIntegration.stimulusActions: Listen for calendar:change and calendar:beforechange on the root or ancestors. The controller does not stop propagation.
consumerIntegration.cancelableHook: Cancel selection with event.preventDefault() in a calendar:beforechange listener.
consumerIntegration.monthNavigation: Consumers navigate months through previous/next buttons and server/Turbo rendering. Selection remains in root values, allowing the controller to restore selection/state after rendering.
consumerIntegration.nested: Use :self or event.target === event.currentTarget to restrict events to the root when listening outside nested calendars.

behavior.scope: Own selection and roving focus only, not month rendering/navigation, week starts, today calculation, or date existence validation.
behavior.comparison: Compare fixed-width zero-padded YYYY-MM-DD strings lexically, matching chronological order without Date objects or time zones.
behavior.singleSelection: Trusted click selects the day. Reclicking the selected day emits no event. Clear selection only by assigning an empty value.
behavior.rangeSelection: With no start, set the clicked day as start and leave end empty. With start only, clicking before it restarts start and clears end; clicking at/after it sets end. With both endpoints set, clicking starts a new range and clears end. Allow one-day ranges with start=end.
behavior.disabledDays: Exclude natively disabled days from selection and roving focus. Do not add disabled data-* attributes.

keyboard.focusModel: Use DOM-order roving tabindex: current day is 0, others -1. Tab enters at the current day.
keyboard.arrows: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move to adjacent enabled days in DOM order, skipping disabled days and stopping at boundaries. Reverse them in RTL as grid does. ArrowUp/ArrowDown move seven DOM positions and do nothing if that destination is missing or disabled.
keyboard.selection: Selection uses native Enter/Space button activation producing click. Add no selection-specific keys.
keyboard.excluded: Cross-month keys, PageUp/PageDown for adjacent months, and Home/End for week boundaries are outside scope. Unrendered month days are absent and week starts depend on locale/consumer rendering. This intentionally differs from APG Date Picker grid navigation; consumer previous/next buttons navigate months.

managedMarkup.aria: Set aria-pressed on all days, true only for the selected single day or range endpoints. State synchronization does not warn. Add no roles or grid role; retain native buttons, intentionally differing from APG Date Picker Dialog grid/aria-selected semantics. Interior range days remain aria-pressed=false, exposing endpoints only to AT.
managedMarkup.wiring: Write day roving tabindex as an operational attribute without completion warnings.
managedMarkup.stateOnly: Manage day data-state, aria-pressed, and tabindex only. Do not aggregate per-day state onto the root.
managedMarkup.preservation: Preserve authored disabled, aria-label, id, and other attributes.

stateOutputs.ownership: Use day data-state for CSS; do not use ARIA attributes as CSS state selectors.
stateOutputs.single: Set data-state="selected" on the selected day and remove data-state from other days.
stateOutputs.range: Set range-start on start, range-end on end, and in-range on interior days. The controller outputs in-range because CSS cannot derive it. When start=end, prefer range-start.

lifecycle: Register root click/keydown/focusin and a MutationObserver for day changes, data-calendar-value, and disabled only while connected. Remove them on disconnect and avoid duplication during Turbo reconnection.
Track day changes, including whole-month replacement, with dayTargetConnected/Disconnected and recompute restored selection, state, and roving focus.
If the roving current day disappears, move the Tab stop to the selected day if available or the first enabled day. Do not move DOM focus; consumers/Turbo own focus after server round trips.
Leave generated data-state and aria-pressed on disconnect().
Do not duplicate listeners or custom events when reconnecting the same instance

observations.item: Pressed date announcements and presentation of range membership
observations.impact: The contract fixes native buttons and aria-pressed for selected dates, without grid roles or a separate in-range ARIA state.

acceptanceCriteria: Required AAA criteria: 2.1.3 Keyboard (No Exception), with no pointer-only features; and 3.2.5 Change on Request, with controller focus movement limited to user actions or consumer JS calls, never timers.
The behavior and accessibility implemented by this component must meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA.
Native click/Enter/Space selection plus roving navigation satisfies 2.1.3.
Range rules match the contract: start then end, restarting when clicking before start, and starting a new range after completion. in-range data-state matches selection.
Restore selection and roving focus from values after whole-month day replacement.
Compare dates lexically without Date objects or time zones.
Only trusted selection changes emit one cancelable beforechange and one committed change. Cancellation preserves selection; programmatic/synthetic paths emit no events.

Use aria-pressed synchronized with selection, not grid role or aria-selected, intentionally differing from APG Date Picker Dialog. Real-device announcements of pressed state and the absence of an in-range ARIA state remain unverified.
Invalid markup disables enhancement with one warning
Pass automated tests in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.

testMatrix.description: Single selected state; range-start/range-end/in-range; aria-pressed; clearing selection; and authored-attribute preservation
Start/end commitment, restarting before start or after completion, and one-day ranges
+/-1 disabled skipping/boundaries, +/-7 week movement and missing/disabled stops, RTL reversal, and roving tabindex
beforechange cancellation, mode-specific detail, ordering, bubbling, reasons, and no events for unchanged values
No events from value/start/end assignment and normalization, including mode mismatch and start after end
Selection restoration and Tab-stop correction after whole-month replacement without DOM focus movement
One warning and disabled enhancement for non-button days, invalid/duplicate/out-of-order values, or invalid mode

testMatrix: Engine-specific results for Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit
Screen-reader results on a real device (unverified)

negativeControls.plannedMutation: Emit calendar:change from the value setter.
